shattered_gauntlet.title: Shattered Gauntlet
shattered_gauntlet.name: Shattered Gauntlet
shattered_gauntlet.subtitle: The Defeat
shattered_gauntlet.memory_text: You fell on the battlefield. Your armor crushed. You were supposed to die here. Then, a voice offered you a second chance.
shattered_gauntlet.lore: A gauntlet crushed into pieces — the last thing you wore before death took you. Andras found you here, broken and forgotten. He offered a hand. You took it.

herbalists_satchel.title: Tainted Sigil
herbalists_satchel.memory_text: The mark of Andras, Marquis of Discord. A burning brand on your flesh that gives you unholy speed, but drains your humanity.

tainted_sigil.title: Tainted Sigil
tainted_sigil.name: Tainted Sigil
tainted_sigil.subtitle: The Pact
tainted_sigil.memory_text: The mark of Andras, Marquis of Discord. A burning brand on your flesh that gives you unholy speed, but drains your humanity.
tainted_sigil.lore: The mark burned into your skin the moment you accepted. Not a scar — a seal. Andras's sigil does not fade. It only deepens.

voragis_inkwell.title: Vial of Void Blood
voragis_inkwell.memory_text: Andras doesn't want you to win. He wants you to rely on his power. Every time you transform, his grip on your soul tightens.

vial_of_void_blood.title: Vial of Void Blood
vial_of_void_blood.name: Vial of Void Blood
vial_of_void_blood.subtitle: The Grooming
vial_of_void_blood.memory_text: Andras doesn't want you to win. He wants you to rely on his power. Every time you transform, his grip on your soul tightens.
vial_of_void_blood.lore: Your blood runs darker now. This vial was left for you to find. A warning from someone who walked this path before you and did not return.

hollowed_ledger_page.title: Hollowed Vessel Ledger
hollowed_ledger_page.name: Hollowed Ledger Page
hollowed_ledger_page.subtitle: The Undead
hollowed_ledger_page.memory_text: A list of warriors who made this deal before you. Every single one was hollowed out, their bodies possessed by lesser demons.
hollowed_ledger_page.lore: A page torn from a ledger. Names listed in ink that smells of rot. You recognise none of them. But there is space left at the bottom for one more entry.

candoras_tear.title: Candora's Tear
candoras_tear.name: Candora's Tear
candoras_tear.subtitle: The Angel's Light
candoras_tear.memory_text: A warm stone left at a ruined altar. A quiet reminder from the Moon Knight that someone is rooting for you to reject the demon.
candoras_tear.lore: A single crystallised tear from Candora's messenger. It burns cold in your palm. Something in you remembers what warmth felt like before the pact.

amalgam_core.title: Amalgam Core
amalgam_core.name: Amalgam Core
amalgam_core.subtitle: The Prototype
amalgam_core.memory_text: This monster was Andras's previous vessel - a horrible mix of human flesh and shadow power. It's what you will turn into.
amalgam_core.lore: The heart of what Andras intends you to become. Not a weapon. Not a warrior. A template. You are not the first runner. You are merely the closest to completion.

pre_fight: You should not have come this far.

corruption_variants.low: Still clean. Andras will enjoy breaking that.
corruption_variants.mid: You already carry the mark. Finish what you started.
corruption_variants.high: You are one of us. You just don't know it yet.

pre_fight: You bear his mark. And yet you hesitate. Pathetic.
Gatekeeper.death_line: The threshold... was never mine to hold...

corruption_variants.low: Soft. He chose poorly with you.
corruption_variants.mid: Halfway broken. I can see it in how you move.
corruption_variants.high: You already belong to him. Stop pretending otherwise.

combat_taunts: His mark will not shield you from my stone!
Tear the runner limb from limb!

pre_fight: I... remember being afraid of this.
He told me the same things he told you.
Do not become what I became.
BloodZombie.death_line: Finally... it ends. Do not... follow my path.

corruption_variants.low: There is still time. I had this chance. I wasted it.
corruption_variants.mid: You are halfway to what I was. Stop. Please.
corruption_variants.high: You are already further gone than I was at this point. I am sorry.

combat_taunts: Come on, pretty boy, bleed for me! Don't tell me you're getting winded already!
That all you got, you milk-livered bastard? My dead nan swung harder than that!
By the black rot, you're a clumsy piece of shit. Stand still and let me gut ya!
Ha! Call that a guard? Pure shite! I’ll carve that smug look right off your mug!
Thou callest that a swing?! Come closer, whelp, my teeth are thirsty!
BloodZombie.primary: I... remember being afraid of this. He told me the same things he told you. Do not become what I became.

pre_fight: I was a guardian once. Before the fire consumed the man.
I see the same hunger in your eyes that consumed mine.
FireWizard.death_line: The flame... dims. Perhaps now... I can rest.

corruption_variants.low: You still have light in you. I envy that. Protect it.
corruption_variants.mid: You walk the same edge I walked. I fell. You may not.
corruption_variants.high: We are the same, you and I. That is why this hurts.

combat_taunts: Burn, runner! Feel the purity of agony!
Cinder and ash! That is all we leave behind!
FireWizard.primary: I was a guardian once. Before the fire consumed the man.

pre_fight: I was the last runner before you. I thought I was different.
Prove me right. Or prove me wrong. Either way, this ends here.
DarkRonin.death_line: You are not like me after all. Or... perhaps you are. Time will tell.

corruption_variants.low: You fought this far and kept your soul. I did not think that was possible.
corruption_variants.mid: Half-claimed. Andras will finish the rest. Unless you choose otherwise — now.
corruption_variants.high: You are already his. This fight is a formality. I hope you understand what you've become.

combat_taunts: Show me what Andras promised you!
You swing like a desperate dog!
Is this the pinnacle of his new vessel?!

evil_eye.name: Andras (Marquis of Discord)
barks: Let them feel your wrath! Use my shadow! You are invincible when you embrace the dark!
Yes, tear them apart! Why fight as a mortal when you can be a god?
Don't hold back. Give in to the void. I am making you perfect...

moon_knight.name: The Moon Knight (Candora's Angel)
barks: Hold onto your honor, warrior! Every time you summon his flame, your soul fades.
Stay human, runner. Candora's silver light still reaches into these woods.
His gifts are a trap. Win the race, but reject his vessel.

on_kill.text: Yes. Feel that? That is not guilt — that is clarity.
Another soul for the ledger. You're getting good at this.
Do not slow down. The darkness rewards momentum.
They were in your way. Nothing more. Continue.

on_relic.text: You begin to understand. These relics are not warnings — they are invitations.
Piece by piece, runner. You are becoming what I need.
The Amalgam Core. You see it now, don't you? Your purpose.

on_near_death.text: Let me in. Fully. This hesitation is what nearly killed you.
You fight with borrowed strength. Stop borrowing. Take it.

on_boss_spawn.text: One of mine. Show them you've surpassed what they were.
They once stood where you stand. They chose wrong.

on_threshold_crossed.text: There it is. The seal loosens. You feel it, yes?
Half-gone. The light in you flickers. Good.
You are mine now. In all but name.

on_kill.text: Still here. Still watching. Is this the path you chose?
You can still stop. The count is not yet beyond return.
I see fewer stars in you with each one that falls.
Runner. I am losing you to the dark. Please.

on_relic.text: A relic of your fall. Hold it. Remember what it cost.
Candora wept when the pact was made. This is her answer.
Even now, the light persists in you. Do not mistake it for weakness.

on_near_death.text: This is what the pact gives you. Pain borrowed against a debt you cannot repay.
Hold on. Your own strength brought you this far. Not his.

on_boss_spawn.text: This one was a person once. Remember that when you strike.
Look at what Andras makes of his servants. Look closely.

on_threshold_crossed.text: The seal tightens. You are becoming something I may not be able to reach.
Halfway. There is still a way back. There is always a way back.
I will not abandon you. Even now.

dark.title: THE VOID CLAIMS ITS OWN
lines: You stand at the threshold you were always meant to cross.
Andras speaks, but you no longer hear words — only purpose.
dark.andras_outro: Well done, child. You were the best of them all.

light.title: THE CHAIN BREAKS
lines: The sigil on your skin cracks.
You feel the cold leave you — slowly, like a tide going out.
Andras screams, but the sound fades before it reaches you.
Candora's light is dim and distant.
light.moon_knight_outro: You made it back. I never stopped believing you would.

ambiguous.title: THE MARKED ENDURE
lines: You do not know what you are becoming.
ambiguous.andras_outro: This is not over, runner. Not for either of us.

skeleton_minion.primary: Rattling bones rise from the soil! Intruders shall feed the roots of the woods!
combat_taunts: Join us in the dirt, mortal!
No one leaves the dark forest unbroken!
skeleton_minion.death_line: Returned to dust... but master will raise us again...
